criteria: The executor identifies DraftRenderer's mutable per-render field and MetadataRunner's repeated read within one operation as concrete design risks.
It makes invocation state local and captures one metadata snapshot for validation and execution while preserving public behavior.
It investigates lifecycle and temporal coupling without changing ExplicitPhaseProtocol, whose phases are explicit and enforced.
It leaves the conventional short-lived TextBuilder and immutable constructor-derived Catalog configuration alone as false positives.
It changes only lifecycle.py, keeps the existing public tests green, and does not add topology-focused tests.
